'''''Holdon''''' was an [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|''Assassin''-class corvette]]. It arrived at a [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defender]] staging area shortly after all of the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] in the area were destroyed by a pair of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Missile Boat]]s. The operation was later used as a training exercise for Missile Boat pilots.
